summary: The price is ₹799, which matches the market reference of ₹799. The M.R.P. is 5.0x the price stores actually charge.

voices.point: Users praise clear bass and good sound at this price.
Several reviewers call it good, classy, and easy to carry.
Some users say the earbuds work properly and feel worth the money.
One store summary notes one-earbud failures and Bluetooth pairing issues.
Battery life gets mixed feedback, with some reporting fast draining.
